title: Operations Cluster Manager
description:
Role: Customer Experience Manager (CEM) Coliving Zolo | Coliving Own the cluster. Drive performance. Deliver consistent experience. Why this role exists Zolo’s coliving business operates at scale across multiple properties in each city. While individual properties are managed by on-ground teams, consistent performance across occupancy, customer experience, and profitability depends on strong cluster-level ownership. Each cluster needs a leader who ensures: Properties are full and revenue targets are met Customer experience is consistent and NPS remains high Teams are trained, disciplined, and aligned Issues are identified early and resolved quickly This role exists to ensure that a cluster of 10–20 properties runs with control, consistency, and accountability — delivering both strong business outcomes and great customer experience. If the CEM is strong, the cluster performs predictably and improves continuously. If the CEM is weak, performance drops, issues repeat, and teams lose direction. Your mandate is clear Own occupancy, NPS, and profitability across your cluster Drive execution discipline and SOP adherence across all properties Build, train, and manage a strong on-ground team Identify and solve operational and customer experience issues Use data and numbers to drive decisions and improvements Ensure properties are audit-ready and consistently maintained This is not a coordination role. It is full ownership of cluster performance and outcomes. About Zolo Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent. People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options. Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey. Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living. Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences. Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline. Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term. What you will be responsible for 1. Own Cluster Performance & Business Outcomes Take full accountability for occupancy, revenue, and margins Track property-level performance metrics regularly Identify underperforming properties and drive improvement Ensure consistent achievement of targets across cluster 2. Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Adherence Ensure all properties follow defined SOPs and checklists Conduct regular reviews with ACEMs and property teams Build structured routines for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking Ensure consistency in execution across all properties 3. Lead & Develop On-Ground Teams Manage ACEMs, property managers, and housekeeping teams Train teams on customer experience, processes, and standards Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions Build a motivated, disciplined, and accountable team 4. Ensure Customer Experience & Manage Escalations Track NPS and customer feedback across properties Handle escalations and ensure quick resolution Drive root cause analysis and prevent repeat issues Ensure consistent guest/resident experience across cluster 5. Use Data & Numbers to Drive Decisions Track key metrics like occupancy, revenue, and cost Use data to identify trends and problem areas Take action based on numbers, not assumptions Drive performance improvements through data-led decisions 6. Audit Properties & Maintain Control Conduct regular property audits (hygiene, operations, processes) Identify gaps and ensure timely closure Maintain high standards across all properties Ensure properties are always audit-ready What success looks like after 6–12 months Cluster consistently meets occupancy and revenue targets High and stable NPS across all properties Strong SOP adherence and execution consistency Reduced escalations and faster issue resolution Well-trained, motivated, and accountable team Clear visibility and control over all properties The cluster runs with discipline, predictability, and strong performance. Who this role is for You will likely thrive here if: You take ownership of outcomes across multiple locations You enjoy managing teams and driving performance You are disciplined and believe in structured execution You are comfortable working with numbers and targets You can handle pressure and make decisions on-ground You want to grow into larger operational leadership roles Experience we value 2–7 years of experience in operations / multi-unit environments Experience managing teams (directly or indirectly) Exposure to customer-facing environments Basic understanding of business metrics (occupancy, revenue, cost) Strong execution and follow-up discipline Hospitality experience is not mandatory. Ownership, leadership, and execution discipline are critical. The impact you will have You directly influence revenue, occupancy, and profitability You shape customer experience across multiple properties You build and develop on-ground teams You ensure operational consistency at scale Why join now Zolo is scaling its coliving business aggressively across cities. Cluster-level execution and leadership will define success. This role is a critical stepping stone to larger city and business leadership roles. If you believe in ownership, discipline, and driving outcomes at scale — this is the right role.

 About Aster DM Healthcare 
 Aster DM Healthcare is one of the leading integrated healthcare providers in the GCC, with a growing presence across multiple countries. The Oman Vertical operates a network of hospitals and clinics, delivering high-quality healthcare services across specialties. 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Manager / Senior Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to support the FP&A and management reporting function for Aster DM Healthcare’s Oman Vertical from Bangalore / Calicut . The role will own end-to-end management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and business partnering across the Oman hospital and clinic network. The position will serve as a key interface with Corporate HQ in Dubai and the Oman Finance leadership team , ensuring accurate, reconciled and timely submission of monthly management reports, budgets, forecasts and standardized HQ reporting templates. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, commercially oriented and comfortable working with senior stakeholders across Finance and Operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Month-End Close & Management Reporting Own end-to-end monthly financial reporting across Oman entities, including consolidated and unit-level P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow . Deliver monthly reporting within defined timelines, including Actuals vs Budget and Prior Year analysis. Prepare detailed variance analysis and management commentary. Prepare and drive the Monthly Management Meeting (MMM) deck , including supporting workings and actionable insights. Prepare monthly Sales & Marketing review decks with detailed financial and operational analysis. Track management actions and ensure timely closure of agreed action points. Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial information across reports, presentations and supporting schedules. 2. Corporate HQ Reporting & Consolidation Own preparation and submission of Corporate HQ reporting templates within prescribed timelines and formats. Prepare operational and financial reporting including Base, Doctor Cost and other standardized HQ MIS . Maintain accurate and updated Facility, Employee and Doctor master data . Support P&L consolidation across Oman entities. Prepare and analyze working capital metrics , including DSO, DPO and DIO. Prepare monthly marketing spend, MVT business MIS and Capex reports for Corporate HQ. Monitor Capex utilization and reporting. Track slow-moving inventory and ensure appropriate utilization/provisioning and reporting. Ensure all HQ submissions are accurate, reconciled and compliant with prescribed formats. 3. Budgeting & Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting process for the Oman Vertical. Drive rolling forecasts and periodic estimates based on business performance and changing assumptions. Translate top-down business targets into bottom-up budgets for individual units. Develop detailed revenue, manpower, Opex and Capex plans. Prepare revenue forecasts by specialty, payor and business unit . Analyze budget vs actual performance and provide recommendations for corrective actions. Partner with business and operational teams to improve financial performance and accountability. 4. Data, MIS & Business Analytics Own and maintain a centralized financial and operational data repository / single source of truth . Ensure data is accurate, reconciled and readily available for management reporting. Standardize KPI definitions and reporting methodologies across entities. Drive automation of recurring reports and MIS. Develop dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI or equivalent tools . Provide periodic revenue and collections flash reports and management insights. Identify trends, risks and opportunities through financial and operational data analysis. 5. Healthcare Business Partnering Partner with the CEO, COO, Head of Finance and business unit leaders to provide actionable financial insights. Analyze key healthcare performance indicators such as: Occupancy ARPOB Case Mix Payor / Insurance Mix Doctor Productivity Revenue & Collections Revenue Cycle Performance Translate operational performance into financial impact and business recommendations. Support leadership in decision-making through timely and reliable financial analysis. Qualifications & Experience Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory. 5+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, management reporting, budgeting and financial analysis. Experience in healthcare / hospital finance is strongly preferred. Strong experience in P&L consolidation and management reporting. Exposure to Oracle EPM / FCCS / GRP consolidation will be an advantage. Experience working with GCC / Middle East finance operations will be an added advantage. At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Operational Excellence Manager __ Your role and responsibilities 

 Energy Industries is establishing an AI Factory as the AI Transformation Engine for the division. The AI Factory will combine governance, expertise, delivery capabilities, reusable assets and capability development to accelerate and scale AI transformation. As AI Factory Operations Manager, you will operate this transformation engine. You will establish a transparent, scalable and predictable delivery environment that enables AI initiatives to move effectively from prioritization through development and deployment. You will orchestrate delivery resources, manage portfolio execution, optimize capacity, coordinate partners and continuously improve the performance of the AI Factory ecosystem. 

 Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide * While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience are matching this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.   This position does not require relocation . The successful candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office 

You will be mainly accountable for: Operate and continuously improve the day-to-day AI Factory delivery framework. Maintain portfolio visibility and provide clear performance reporting. Establish effective operational governance and working practices. Coordinate delivery activities across the divisional AI portfolio. Maintain transparency on status, risks, dependencies, capacity and delivery performance. Ensure effective stage-gate execution and delivery against cost, time and quality expectations. Support portfolio prioritization and capacity planning. Evaluate the capability, effectiveness and performance of internal delivery teams. Identify development and improvement opportunities across those teams. Recommend scaling, restructuring, consolidation or closure actions when appropriate. Coordinate external delivery partners and vendors. Work with the AI Lead Architect to determine the most appropriate internal, external or combined delivery approach. Manage operational delivery performance within authority delegated by the AI Factory Steering Committee. Coordinate the execution of AI Academy initiatives. Ensure that training programs, certifications and learning activities are delivered effectively. Monitor progress in developing AI capabilities across Energy Industries. Support AI Factory Steering Committee activities. Prepare reporting and decision-support materials. Ensure adherence to approved governance processes. Support business-case governance, investment tracking and portfolio transparency. 

 You will coordinate a global network of delivery teams, project managers, architects, subject matter experts and vendor partners. The wider AI Factory delivery ecosystem includes professionals across functions and geographies. Impact of this role comes from operational leadership, planning, governance and execution management across a complex virtual delivery environment. 

 Qualifications for the role Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Technology, Program Management or a related field. At least 5 years of experience in program delivery, operations management, PMO leadership, transformation, consulting or a comparable environment. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary or virtual delivery teams. Experience working with executive stakeholders. Strong planning, governance and operational management capabilities. Experience managing delivery risks, dependencies, capacity and performance. Professional fluency in English. Willingness to travel internationally approximately 20 percent. Preferred background Experience in AI, analytics, digitalization, automation or technology delivery. Experience in an industrial, energy, engineering or technology environment. Balance delivery speed with quality and governance. Are comfortable operating under ambiguity and changing priorities. Influence teams and partners without relying solely on formal reporting lines. Focus on execution, learning and continuous improvement. Have the resilience and drive needed to establish a new global capability. 
 *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive. description:
Job Description - Clinic Assistant 
 1. Job Details 
 Job Title: Clinic Assistant
 Salary: To be confirmed
 Team: Clinical Operations
 Location: Indiranagar
 Reports to: Clinical Operations Manager 
 2. Organisational Context 
 Join Us at The Centre for ADHD Research and Excellence: Shaping the Future of Accessible Healthcare 
At CARE ADHD, we're revolutionizing private healthcare by making ADHD assessments and treatment more affordable and accessible to those who need it. Our client-centred approach, combined with lean methodology and a focus on continuous improvement, drives our commitment to excellence. We embrace an innovative mindset, encouraging rapid learning and adaptation through our 'fail fast' ethos. With ambitious plans to become the largest ADHD service provider outside the NHS within the next five years, we are committed to pushing boundaries and fostering innovation.
Care is at the heart of who we are in how we support patients, and in how we treat each other as colleagues. We believe the way we show up for each other is just as important as what we do. Skills matter, but its our mindset, behaviours and willingness to learn, adapt and improve that protect the supportive culture weve built, and help us thrive together.
 3. Job Purpose 
The Receptionist cum Nurse will play a dual role in ensuring the smooth functioning of clinic reception and providing essential nursing support to patients and clinicians.
The postholder will:
i. Welcome patients and provide a professional, empathetic, and supportive first point of contact, helping create a positive and accessible clinic experience for individuals, including neurodivergent patients.
ii. Monitor and accurately record vital signs, including blood pressure and pulse, for patients attending medication appointments, promptly escalating abnormal readings or clinical concerns to the designated clinician.
iii. Support booking and rescheduling processes, manage front desk enquiries, and guide patients through the relevant appointment procedures.
iv. Maintain accurate and confidential patient records, prepare consultation rooms, and assist clinicians with routine patient-care activities within the scope of their qualifications and competence.
v. Contribute to the effective day-to-day running of the clinic by maintaining an organised and welcoming environment, communicating effectively with the clinical team, and identifying opportunities to improve patient experience and operational processes.
 4. Structure Chart 
 Suggested reporting structure 
Clinical Operations Manager

Clinic Assistant

Clinical Team (Psychiatrists and Clinical Psychologist)
The Clinic Assistant will report to the Clinical Operations Manager and work closely with clinicians and ensure patients receive timely assistance.
 5.Core Duties and Responsibilities (Key Result Areas) 
Key responsibilities will include:
 a. Clinical Support and Vital Signs Monitoring 
 Measure, record, and document patients' vital signs, including blood pressure and pulse, particularly for patients attending psychiatric medication appointments. Ensure observations are recorded accurately and communicated promptly to the treating clinician. Escalate abnormal readings, patient concerns, or any signs of clinical deterioration in accordance with established clinical protocols. Assist clinicians with routine patient-care activities within the scope of nursing qualifications, training, and competence. Prepare patients for consultations and support the clinical team in maintaining a safe and organised care environment. Ensure clinical equipment is clean, available, and functioning appropriately, and report any faults or concerns. b. Planning & Organising 
 Manage front desk activities, including welcoming patients, handling telephone calls, responding to enquiries, and directing patients to the appropriate clinician. Guide patients through the appropriate processes for appointment bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, and follow-up appointments. Maintain organised patient documentation and support accurate record-keeping. c. Service Improvement 
 Identify opportunities to improve reception processes, patient coordination, and the overall clinic experience. Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) and contribute feedback where processes could be made more efficient. Promote a patient-centred and neurodiversity-affirming environment, considering individual communication preferences and sensory needs. Maintain a clean, welcoming, accessible, and organised clinic environment. d. Analysis & Judgement 
 Recognise and promptly escalate abnormal vital-sign readings or patient concerns to the appropriate clinician. Exercise sound judgement when prioritising patient enquiries, appointment coordination, and routine clinic activities. Identify discrepancies in patient records or appointment information and seek clarification when required. Follow clinical protocols and established procedures, seeking guidance from the designated clinician or manager when situations fall outside the scope of the role. Maintain accuracy and attention to detail when documenting patient observations and updating records. e. Communication 
 Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with patients, clinicians, colleagues, and other relevant stakeholders. Provide patients with clear guidance on appointment procedures, including bookings, cancellations, rescheduling, and follow-up arrangements. Communicate relevant patient observations and concerns promptly to the clinical team. Adapt communication to accommodate the needs and preferences of neurodivergent individuals, including allowing additional processing time and providing clear, structured information where appropriate. Maintain patient confidentiality and communicate sensitive information discreetly and in accordance with clinic policies. 6. Person Specification

Knowledge & Experience Minimum of one year of experience in a hospital, clinic, or healthcare setting.Previous experience in a mental health, psychiatric, or ADHD clinic. Basic knowledge of measuring and recording vital signs, including blood pressure and pulse.Experience monitoring vital signs for patients attending psychiatric medication appointments. Understanding of patient confidentiality, accurate documentation, and safe patient handling.Experience working with neurodivergent individuals or individuals with mental health needs. Understanding of reception activities, patient coordination, and appointment management.Familiarity with electronic medical records or clinic management systems. Skills & Abilities Ability to measure, record, and communicate vital-sign observations accurately.Experience using digital tools for appointment scheduling and patient record management. Good verbal and written communication skills.Ability to support patients with diverse communication and sensory needs. Basic computer skills and the ability to maintain accurate records.Knowledge of service improvement practices and standard operating procedures. Ability to organise workload, manage competing priorities, and maintain an orderly reception area.Experience coordinating appointments across multiple clinicians. Ability to recognise concerns and escalate them promptly to the appropriate clinician. Interpersonal Skills Empathetic, respectful, and patient-centred approach to care.Experience supporting neurodivergent patients in a healthcare setting. Ability to communicate professionally with patients, clinicians, and colleagues.Awareness of neurodiversity-affirming and inclusive care practices. Commitment to maintaining confidentiality, dignity, and respect for all patients. Ability to work collaboratively and adapt to changing clinic requirements. Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and contribute to continuous improvement.

title: Head Operations
description:
Director Operations Oct 16, 2026 • Role snapshot Tan90 is hiring a Director – Operations to own production, supply chain and Cooling-as-a-Service operations end to end, and to build the operating engine that takes the company from 100 Cr to 500 Cr and beyond. 
 Title 
 Director – Operations Location 
 Bengaluru (HSR Layout), with regular travel to plants and CaaS cities Reports to 
 Co-Founder & CEO Leads 
 Production, Supply Chain & Procurement, CaaS Operations Experience 
 15+ years, of which 5+ in senior operations leadership Compensation 
 60 LPA fixed + ESOPs About Tan90 Tan90 Thermal Solutions is a materials science company building thermal management and cold chain infrastructure. Born out of IIT Madras and headquartered in Bengaluru, we design and manufacture Phase Change Material (PCM) based cooling products that keep goods at the right temperature without depending on diesel or an always-on grid. Our Cooling-as-a-Service (CaaS) model powers temperature-controlled last-mile delivery for India's leading quick commerce and modern retail players, and we are now extending our PCM technology into HVAC and data centre cooling. Tan90 has grown 2x year on year since inception, is targeting 100 Cr revenue this financial year, and is expanding CaaS from 23 to 35 cities, with a new 20,000 sq ft manufacturing and CaaS facility in Delhi NCR and further facilities planned. We are backed by NAB Ventures, Blue Ashva Capital, Capital A and 3i Partners. The role Our next phase of growth is an operations problem as much as a sales one. Every new city, every new client and every new product line means more panels manufactured, more material moved, more boxes filled and returned on time, and tighter temperature adherence at higher volumes. As Director – Operations, you will bring production, supply chain and CaaS operations under one leader and one operating rhythm. You will be the CEO's partner in turning a fast-growing startup into a company that runs predictably at 5x its current scale, with the systems, people and unit economics to match. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set strategy, but you will also be on the shop floor and in the dark stores when it matters. Key responsibilities CaaS operations Own day-to-day CaaS delivery across all cities, from panel charging and box dispatch to returns and reverse logistics. Drive the core CaaS metrics: daily fill rate, asset return rate, temperature adherence, delivery time adherence, and panel and box hygiene. Lead city launches as CaaS expands from 23 to 35 cities, building a repeatable playbook for setting up hubs, hiring city teams and reaching steady state fast. Manage asset utilisation, loss and turnaround across a large and growing fleet of panels and boxes. Be the operational counterpart for our largest quick commerce and retail clients, with clear SLAs and escalation paths. Production Own manufacturing across Bengaluru, Delhi NCR and upcoming facilities: capacity planning, throughput, yield, quality and safety. Scale output to meet demand from CaaS, product sales and exports without compromising quality. Introduce lean manufacturing, standard work and quality systems appropriate for a hardware company at our stage. Work closely with R&D to industrialise new products, including PCM solutions for HVAC and data centres. Supply chain and procurement Build a resilient supplier base for raw materials, components and packaging, with sound cost, lead time and quality controls. Own demand and supply planning, inventory, warehousing and inbound and outbound logistics. Manage logistics partners and transport costs across a high-frequency, multi-city network. Drive cost-down programs that improve gross margin as volumes grow. Team, systems and leadership Lead and grow the production, supply chain and CaaS teams, including city and plant managers, hiring and developing the next layer of leaders. Set up the operating cadence: KPIs, dashboards, weekly reviews and a clear chain of accountability. Choose and roll out the ERP, WMS and field-ops tooling we need to run at scale. Own the operations budget and partner with finance on capex, unit economics and cash flow. Work with the CEO and leadership team on strategy, annual planning and fundraising diligence. What success looks like In your first 90 days, you will have mapped every part of the operation, put a single KPI dashboard in front of the leadership team, and fixed the two or three bottlenecks that most limit growth. By 12 months, CaaS will be live in 35 cities with consistent service levels across all of them, production capacity will be ahead of demand, and operating cost per unit will be visibly lower. By 24 months, operations will be running at a scale that supports 500 Cr in revenue, including exports, with a strong second line of leaders in place and systems that no longer depend on any one person. Who you are Must-haves 15+ years in operations, with at least 5 years leading multi-function teams at senior level. Deep experience in FMCG operations with high order volumes and high-frequency movement of goods across many locations. Hands-on exposure to logistics: transport, distribution, warehousing and last-mile or reverse logistics. A proven record of scaling operations in a company to 1,000 Cr or more in revenue, and the ability to explain exactly what you built to get there. Experience leading large teams, including managers of managers, across plants, warehouses or field locations. Strong command of numbers: unit economics, cost structures, capacity models and operating budgets. Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can build process without slowing a startup down. Good to have Cold chain, temperature-controlled logistics or quick commerce experience. Manufacturing experience in hardware, consumer durables, packaging or materials. Exposure to asset-heavy, rental or service-based business models. Experience setting up operations for exports. An engineering degree; an MBA in operations or supply chain is a plus. Accenture is a leading technology consulting firm specializing in data center transformation and infrastructure optimization. We partner with hyperscalers, enterprises, and colocation providers to design scalable, efficient data center networks that support AI workloads, edge computing, and sustainable operations. Job Summary 
The Data Center Strategy Manager will lead end-to-end consulting services for clients' data center portfolios, guiding them through capacity forecasting, site selection, and expansion strategies. You will optimize client designs for power efficiency and sustainability while directing cross-functional teams to deliver multi-year execution roadmaps. This role requires a visionary leader blending technical expertise with business acumen to ensure clients achieve strategic superiority and excellence.

Lead evaluations for new technologies like liquid cooling, 800G networking, and modular DC designs to support AI/GPU workloads. Collaborate with clients' finance, operations, and engineering teams to create CapEx/OpEx models, ROI analyses, and vendor RFPs for DC builds and upgrades. Oversee sustainability initiatives, targeting PUE reductions, renewable energy integration, and compliance with global carbon regulations. Manage a team of strategic consultants and analysts, mentoring on DC best practices and fostering innovation in edge and hyperscale environments. Conduct risk assessments for supply chain, geopolitics, and resilience, recommending strategies for multi-region redundancy. Present strategies to executive leadership and board, translating technical roadmaps into business impacts like TCO savings and uptime guarantees. Mentor, coach, and develop future consultants through hiring, training, and upskilling efforts, building and inspiring high-performing diverse teams. Contribute to Accenture's knowledge assets, white papers, and represent the practice at key events and industry bodies as a thought leader. Preferred Skills Proven track record managing DC portfolios valued at $500M+ in assets. Deep expertise in DC metrics (PUE, WUE), architectures (spine-leaf, DCI), and tools (DCIM like Nlyte, Sunbird). Experience with major vendors (e.g., Schneider, Vertiv, Arista, NVIDIA) and standards (Uptime Institute Tier certifications, LEED). Strong analytical skills with proficiency in financial modeling (Excel, Tableau) and project management (e.g., PMP or Agile). Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills for C-level presentations. Awareness of emerging technologies-AI, GenAI, Edge, Analytics, Cloud-and ability to drive their adoption in next-generation data centers. title: Data Curation SME - Liquid tumors
description:
Part of the Oncology Clinical Team, working on building and developing Oncology Data dictionaries, liquid tumor pipeline from scratch and SOP creation by acting as an SME for the liquid tumor portfolio, along with secondary duties of Curation/Abstraction etc.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Curation Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Liquid Cancers to join our Oncology Clinical Team. This role will focus on the review of clinical data specifically related to hematologic malignancies (e.g., leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma), and contribution to the development of data dictionaries, SOPs, and AI training pipelines to support oncology trials. Abstraction and curation may also be required based on project requirements. 

Essential Job Functions:

Serve as the oncology data curation SME for various liquid tumor types.
Develop and maintain liquid tumor data libraries; coordinate with cross-functional teams to meet project-specific requirements - from a data curation/RWE perspective.
Contribute proactively to pipeline optimization for liquid tumors.
Apply critical thinking to identify, troubleshoot, and escalate issues during data pipeline operations.
Proactively contribute to streamlining processes specifically to the liquid tumor pipeline.
Ability and flexibility to render support to other projects when there is a team requirement.
Conduct additional duties as assigned, including review of selected medical records to assess eligibility for new project, performing second level reviews/QC review of medical records.
Screening of cases for relevant clinical trials across various projects and/or disease subtypes. 
Knowledge related to cancer trials is essential and required, including understanding their inclusion and exclusion criteria.
Respond promptly to queries issued by the Lead Data Abstractor, Operations Manager or other project personnel.
Access electronic data systems for review of medical records and enter specific data into congruent electronic data systems.
Ability to understand the Inclusion, Exclusion criteria, adverse event, hospitalization data, medications details and categorize the data accordingly.
Review project specific documents, as needed, to develop familiarity with project goals and with the Abstractor tasks in each project.
Ability to understand the diagnostic, pathology and other reports and obtain the exact information required according to trial specific SOPs.
Use other resources as needed to gain the knowledge required to perform Abstractor work on new projects.
Share medical knowledge and project-specific procedural knowledge with other Data Abstractors as needed.

Qualification:

Minimum 4-5 years experience across data abstraction/curation, with a strong focus on liquid tumors and/or expertise is essential - Previous experience in a data curation SME role is desirable.
In depth knowledge across the liquid tumor domain with a solid understanding of foundational liquid tumor concepts is also essential. 
Oncology experience is preferable; familiarity with how cancer is treated from diagnosis through treatment and recovery and an understanding of cancer terminology is essential.
Experience in clinical research or related fields, especially in oncology trials is preferred.
An advanced level of clinical knowledge associated with chronic disease states is required.
Experience in clinical research or reviewed medical data for clinical trials.
Certification done in clinical research or clinical data management.

Education: 

B.Sc (Nursing), BDS, BAMS, BHMS, MDS, BPharm, MPharm 

Skills and Abilities:

Flexibility: Flexibility in coping with changing work assignments, changing project requirements, varying training meeting schedules, and database resources that may not always function optimally.
Innovation and Proactiveness: Should be able to foresee the probable functionalities and/or think out of the box as complex problems may sometimes require innovative solutions.
Language: Strong communication skills both written and verbal to work with multiple internal and external clients in a fast paced environment.
Reasoning: Ability to make independent judgments in abstracting medical data and the knowledge of when to seek input from other staff.
Computer: Ability to create and maintain documents using Microsoft office( word, excel, outlook and powerpoint)

Why Join US ?

We are revolutionizing a unique industry that has the potential to impact and benefit patients from all over the world - you can create impact at scale.
We have had company - sponsored workations in Bali, Sri Lanka, and Manali and take pride in our hard-working yet super fun culture .
We are working on a few of the most challenging problems in a highly regulated industry which provides you an opportunity to solve some of the most interesting things.
You will get a chance to work with experts from multiple industries and the best in the industry compensation.

title: Associate Director- Operation
description:
About Loadshare LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart:  Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.  Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.  Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.  Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.  Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.  Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco  
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Job Responsibilities:  Hyperlocal/Quick-Commerce Network Expansion:  Launch and scale the operations across cities from scratch including hub setup, staffing, and training.  Plan and execute city-level ramp-ups, pilot projects, and cost modeling exercises.  Operational Excellence:  Ensure adherence to SLAs and quality metrics (GM/CM%, RTO, etc.).  Drive performance audits and implement SOPs to optimize cost-per-order and improve customer experience.  Cost Strategy & Profitability:  Develop and own the P&L for assigned zones; implement cost-effective strategies in manpower, infra, and routing.  Partner with finance to ensure accurate reconciliation, cash management, and profitability at the micro-hub level.  Team Management & Grooming:  Hire, train, and groom delivery personnel and on-ground operation leads via structured OJT and performance tracking mechanisms.  Drive a high-performance culture through regular reviews, productivity benchmarks, and upskilling.  Stakeholder Management:  Coordinate closely with client partners to align on daily ops, performance expectations, and escalation handling.  Support inter-city ops alignment, especially in expanding geographies.  Experience: 3–8 years in hyperlocal/Quick-commerce logistics; must have led operations and 3P logistics in a leadership role.  Industry Exposure: Hyperlocal delivery, ecommerce logistics, food/grocery delivery, or quick commerce.  Skill Set:   Strong command over ground operations and supply chain mechanics (Last Mile). Analytical mindset with a focus on cost vs. performance.  Excellent team handling, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.

Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart:  Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.  Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.  Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.  Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.  Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.  Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco  
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Job Responsibilities:  Hyperlocal/Quick-Commerce Network Expansion:  Launch and scale the operations across cities from scratch including hub setup, staffing, and training.  Plan and execute city-level ramp-ups, pilot projects, and cost modeling exercises.  Operational Excellence:  Ensure adherence to SLAs and quality metrics (GM/CM%, RTO, etc.).  Drive performance audits and implement SOPs to optimize cost-per-order and improve customer experience.  Cost Strategy & Profitability:  Develop and own the P&L for assigned zones; implement cost-effective strategies in manpower, infra, and routing.  Partner with finance to ensure accurate reconciliation, cash management, and profitability at the micro-hub level.  Team Management & Grooming:  Hire, train, and groom delivery personnel and on-ground operation leads via structured OJT and performance tracking mechanisms.  Drive a high-performance culture through regular reviews, productivity benchmarks, and upskilling.  Stakeholder Management:  Coordinate closely with client partners to align on daily ops, performance expectations, and escalation handling.  Support inter-city ops alignment, especially in expanding geographies.  Experience: 3–8 years in hyperlocal/Quick-commerce logistics; must have led operations and 3P logistics in a leadership role.  Industry Exposure: Hyperlocal delivery, ecommerce logistics, food/grocery delivery, or quick commerce.  Skill Set:   Strong command over ground operations and supply chain mechanics (Last Mile). Analytical mindset with a focus on cost vs. performance.  Excellent team handling, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.

title: Junior Manager - Global Reward and Benefits Operations
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Benefits Case Specialist - Global Benefits Operations Level: L5C Reports To: Manager - Global Benefits Operations (Bangalore) 
 
 About the Function 
 Human Resources is about shaping the experience of working at Diageo and helping our people learn and grow every day. From attracting talent to developing careers, this team plays a central role in building a culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to grow. They work closely with teams across the business, bringing insight, care and commercial understanding to everything they do. You'll help create an environment where different perspectives are valued and where people can learn new skills and thrive, unlocking potential across a truly global organisation. 
 
 Context/Scope 
 As part of the Group Reward and Benefits Operations team, you will play a crucial role in developing a high-performing and highly engaged Global Benefits Operations team. Reporting directly to the Assistant Manager - Global Reward and Benefits Operations, your responsibilities will include leading critical activities such as Benefits Purchase Order creation, invoice management and reconciliation, vendor management, report generation and distribution, and query management. Your outstanding customer management, financial control, governance application, and execution skills will be key to the success of these projects. Applying extensive experience in HR and payroll operations, or HR and payroll service delivery, process engineering, and process simplification, you will implement best practices processes and data management strategies to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy across multiple regions and time zones. Proficiency in employee communications for benefits programs, ensuring clear and effective dissemination of information. Skilled in benefits process design to optimize efficiency and effectiveness of program administration. Strong analytical skills to assess and improve benefits program performance and outcomes. Expertise in vendor management, encompassing performance monitoring, invoice and payment management, issue resolution, relationship management, and service review and improvement. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 a) Financial Ensure timely and accurate completion of all in-scope reporting activities. Regularly review and update Process Steps, Maps, Work Instructions, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets, and FAQs. Make them available to relevant teams, conduct necessary training, and ensure consistency and accuracy in all communications materials. Perform all CARM controls and data reconciliations, resolving any issues. Review and reconcile vendor invoices within agreed timelines to ensure payments are made as per the agreed SLAs. 
 
 Leadership Responsibilities 
 Leverage insights to find opportunities for process and workflow improvements. Apply strong social skills to motivate multiple teams, business processes, and data and technical governance. Drive significant simplification and efficiency in processes and systems to support the global productivity agenda. Ensure all controls and processes meet internal and external regulatory requirements. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across Diageo and with vendor teams. 
 
 About this role 
 Purpose of Role The Global Reward Operations (GRO) team supports various benefit processes (e.g., product allowance, car allowance, health insurance) for European markets. The Junior Manager will define, document, and improve both online and offline benefit processes and ensure a successful annual benefit enrollment for the entire European population. The role aims to scope out, document, and enhance the respective processes across Europe, reviewing and updating procedures in accordance with new legislation and regulatory requirements. 
 
 You will be responsible for 
 Top 3-7 Accountabilities Ensure all in-scope reporting activities are completed accurately and on time. Regularly review and update Step Maps, Work Instructions, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets, and FAQs, making them accessible to appropriate teams, and ensuring consistency and accuracy in communications materials. Perform all CARM controls and data reconciliations, resolving any issues. Continuously find opportunities to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. Implement process improvements and automation initiatives to streamline operations and drive business results. Demonstrate strong experience with Workday operations, ensuring all required actions are implemented in the system to facilitate benefits administration and other processes. Ensures continuous improvement by developing effective benefits process designs to optimize efficiency and effectiveness in program administration. Responsible for applying strong analytical skills to assess and enhance benefits program performance and outcomes. Demonstrates strong vendor management skills overseeing performance monitoring to ensure optimal outcomes. 
 
 Experience/Skills Required 
 
 Qualifications and Experience Required 
 Strong understanding of HR processes and data management Payroll experience is highly valued. Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills. Vendor management skills Employee communication Strong analytical skills Process designing Methodical, logical, organized, and flexible approach to work. Excellent English language skills. High attention to detail. Advanced MS Excel skills, including formulas and pivot tables. Experience in process mapping. Experience in extracting and reconciling data from various sources. Barriers to Success in Role Inability to lead change within the business. Difficulty in quickly establishing links and leading mixed business and partner teams. Failure to apply a continuous improvement mentality. Lack of credibility with internal and external stakeholders. Lack of business situational awareness. Inability to collaborate in line with Diageo's dial-up behaviors. Hesitating or waiting for perfect conditions before implementing bold, exciting ideas. Suppressing dissent to achieve team unity. Disengaging when disagreeing with a decision. Adding extensive checkpoints to the process to mitigate risk.

Job Summary 
 We are seeking full-time veterinary clinicians to join our organization and provide high-quality care to our patients and clients, and you will have the opportunity to use state-of-the-art equipment and facilities. You will also enjoy a supportive and friendly work environment that values your skills and expertise. Vacancies: Five. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Provide emergency veterinary services and ongoing care for companion animals (including exotics) Diagnose and make therapeutic treatment recommendations on small companion animals Strict adherence to policies, procedures and protocols Provide support and training to trainees, veterinarians and veterinary nurses in all aspects of patient care Maintain accurate hospital patient records promptly Ensure accurate and complete estimations and billing of all cases during shift and adhere to relevant hospital policy Communicate directly with clients to ensure they are fully informed of prescribed treatments and costs Participate in the shifts as per the rota and the service requirements Manage workflow effectively within the department and ensure all necessary duties are completed in a timely manner Develop and maintain good working relationships with referring veterinarians, both within Cessna and outside practices Manage adverse incidents and complaints appropriately, resolve if possible and bring to the attention of the Veterinary Practice Coordinator or Hospital Operations Manager 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Essential 
 BVSc AH with minimum four years of clinical experience. Vets with small animal practice experience will be given more weightage Masters in clinical subject with minimum three years of experience (Medicine, Surgery, Reproduction) Ability to work rotational shift work, including night shifts, weekends and public holidays and be flexible in work hour patterns Excellent organizational, time and workload management skills, including the ability to prioritize workload to meet strict deadlines Highly effective communication, customer service and interpersonal skills, and the demonstrated ability to interact constructively and collaboratively with staff at all levels of the organization Demonstrated ability to use initiative, assume responsibility for tasks and projects and to resolve problems Demonstrated ability to work cohesively in a team environment 
 
 Desirable 
 Previous experience working in a veterinary hospital or veterinary referral hospital Demonstrated computer skills and experience with computer systems used in veterinary practices, in particular VetBuddy/patient management software Experience in a busy, dynamic and time-sensitive environment 
 
 Behavioral 
 Treat everyone equitably; act fairly with staff and demonstrate respect for diversity Be an effective team player who is cooperative and gains the trust and support of staff, peers and clients through teamwork Enthusiastic Pays attention to detail The flexibility to undertake work during weekends/outside regular hours as required, following rota, occasionally
